clip_research.source_claim: The strength in the August jobs report is due to an unusually mild seasonal adjustment by BLS, not an increase in underlying job growth.
clip_research.public_baseline: The August 2024 jobs report showed 142,000 jobs added (seasonally adjusted), which was below expectations, and the unemployment rate was 4.2%.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The clip claims 162,000 jobs added on a seasonally adjusted basis, which contradicts the official BLS figure of 142,000 for August 2024. The clip may refer to a different month or year, but the numbers do not match the public record.

evidence.fact: Anna Wong claims that on a nonseasonally adjusted basis, jobs added were 154,000, and on a seasonally adjusted basis, 162,000, and that the strength is due to an unusually mild seasonal adjustment.

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
